# A09-S14: Publicity

Correspondence extract. Omissions are marked […].

[…]

How cool! 
 Did you write inside MyNewsDesk or how did the interest suddenly appear? 
 I heard on P1, Orientation, that there was an employee at Google who was sent home because he claimed that one of their algorithms had now become so powerful that it required consent from researchers and displayed emotions and social intelligence. I didn’t get to hear more, but that’s a headline of great weight – and also a nightmare scenario if no one has control over it.
